name: Thresh
title: the Chain Warden

Q.name: Death Sentence
Q.description: Thresh throws out his scythe, Stunning the first unit hit and Pulling them towards Thresh for 1.5 seconds. The scythe does 100/150/200/250/300 + 0.9×AP magic damage and also grants True Sight for the duration. Thresh can Recast this Ability to pull himself to the enemy. If this Ability hits, its Cooldown is reduced by 2 seconds.
Q.summary: Thresh binds an enemy in chains and pulls them toward him. Activating this ability a second time pulls Thresh to the enemy.

W.name: Dark Passage
W.description: Thresh throws his lantern, allowing an ally to click on it to dash to Thresh. The lantern also grants 50/70/90/110/130 + ? Shield for 4 seconds to Thresh and the first ally champion to come in contact with it.
W.summary: Thresh throws out a lantern that shields nearby allied Champions from damage. Allies can click the lantern to dash to Thresh.

E.name: Flay
E.description: Passive: Thresh's Attacks deal additional damage based on how long since he last Attacked. They deal between ? and ? + 0.9/1.2/1.5/1.8/2.1×AD magic damage. Active: Thresh whips his chains, Pulling or Pushing enemies in the direction of the swing. Enemies hit are also Slowed by 20/25/30/35/40% for 1 second and take 65/110/155/200/245 + 0.6×AP magic damage.
E.summary: Thresh's attacks wind up, dealing more damage the longer he waits between attacks. When activated, Thresh sweeps his chain, knocking all enemies hit in the direction of the blow.

R.name: The Box
R.description: Thresh creates a prison of spectral walls, Slowing champions by 99% for 2 seconds and dealing 200/350/500 + 1×AP magic damage. Walls break after one collision, and after one is broken, the rest deal no damage and Slow for half duration.
R.summary: A prison of walls that slow and deal damage if broken.

Passive.name: Damnation
Passive.description: Thresh can harvest the souls of enemies that die near him, permanently granting him Armor and Ability Power.
Passive.summary: Thresh can harvest the souls of enemies that die near him, permanently granting him Armor and Ability Power.

curve.items: medium – support items, armor from souls
